Interpreting the totals

A season-level view of Seattle

Record, games played, and scoring are calculated only from uniquely identified 2026 regular-season games with direct final scores. Offensive totals appear only when an explicit Seahawks team-season record matches that season and game count; player rows are never summed into team totals.
